event_action.description: Action type of the Event - create|update|delete etc

country.description: The geographical or structural location at which the event has occurred.ISO 3166-1-alpha2 country codes.

source_id.description: The Event Origin or System or application that produced the event - BNFB - BGGG - BGB4

schema_name.description: The geographical or structural location at which the event has occurred.ISO 3166-1-alpha2 country codes.

origination_timestamp.description: The timestamp when the event is initiated by the event origin or produced by the producer

trx_ind.description: LOGAUDIT01-{uuidv4} The uuidv4 is an autogenerated value

uuid.description:
Unique Identifier Distinctive ten (10) characters value representing a single event record; formatted alpha-
numerically

timestamp.description: Full date and time of when the event was recorded in the channel, including relevant time- zone information if not in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC); formatted as either: DD/MMM/YYYYThh:mm:ss-tttt o YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss-tttt

classification.description: Identification of the type of event log record being generated using the following qualifiers: (0A) Security Log, (0B) Audit Log, (0C) Error Log, (0D) Access Log, (0E) Transaction Log, (0F) External Log

priority.description: Ranking the event specific to its potential impact using the following qualifiers: (00) Low: response is required using standard procedures as time permits, (10) Medium: response is required using standard procedures within normal operating structures, (20) High: immediate response is required to assess the situation

category.description: Ranking the event specific to the type of interaction and communication occurring between systems and users using the following qualifiers: (00) Initiated: activities associated with the event were started, (10) Suspended: activities associated with the event were temporarily stopped, (20) Interrupted: activities associated with the event have been intervened, (30) Recycled: activities associated with the event were restarted, (40) Terminated: activities associated with the event were terminated, (50) Assigned: characteristic or property was designated to the system or user, (60) Released: characteristic or property was revoked from the system or user

source_host_name.description: Fully qualified name of the system where the event originated; formatted as: <<epm-systemname>>.<<account_name>>

source_ip_address.description: IP Address where the event originated; formatted as: 10.1.1.1 (version 4 standard), 2001:0db8:0000:0042:0000:8a2e:0370:7334 (version 6 standard)

destination_host_name.description: Fully qualified name of the system where the event terminated; formatted as: <<epm-systemname>>.<<account_name>>

destination_ip_address.description: IP Address where the event received; formatted as: 10.1.1.1 (version 4 standard), 2001:0db8:0000:0042:0000:8a2e:0370:7334 (version 6 standard)

session_identifier.description: Distinctive value that represents a specific communication between systems and users, will store the user session

audit_action.description: Action taken by the system or user during this event using the following qualifiers: (00) Read: an object was accessed by the system or user, (10) Write: an object was created or modified by the system or user, (20) Execute: an object was run by the system or user, (30) Delete: an object was removed by the system or user, (40) Enumerate: several objects were listed by the system or user

legacy_ind.description: Action identifier to indicate whether the origin of the message content is legacy or not: true: The request comes from told, false: The request comes from API

message.description:
Detailed information about the event not contained within any other attribute
field of the event record.
